what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Iran in Iraq: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5812 Iranian asylum seekers in Iraq, 11.8% of all asylum seekers from Iran.
Refugees from Iran, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1997 to 2025, most recently with Jaish al-Adl.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 852 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 6602, at the end of 2018.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Iraq.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Iraq only.
